_doc: T-350 / Act 2 — the DEPLOY-CANDIDATE allocation. The approved plan gives RANGES (VOO core ~80-85%, MTUM satellite 15-20%), so the exact split is a judgement inside an approved envelope and lives HERE, changeable without a code deploy. The default sits at the CONSERVATIVE end on non-data grounds: T-318/T-320 found long-only momentum the only CI-significant tilt but with ~half its premium decayed, so the smallest approved dose. Bands are in SHARE QUANTA, not percentage points, because a band below the trade quantum cannot bind (T-297's argument) — at a $10k budget one VOO share is ~6% of the book and one MTUM share ~2.3%, so a flat deadband would mean two different things. buy_quanta > sell_quanta is the buy/hold spread: stricter to add than to trim. NOTHING here is fitted to data.

bands._doc: buy/sell in share-quanta of the instrument governed; max_drift is the absolute-weight backstop that binds regardless of quantum.
